build_GaussianDiffusion: build a GaussianDiffusion instance with a linear beta schedule and MSE loss type for training
create_beta_schedule: create a linear or cosine beta schedule for a given number of diffusion timesteps
sample_p_sample_loop: generate denoised samples from noise using the standard DDPM sampling loop with optional conditioning
sample_ddim_sample_loop: generate denoised samples using the faster DDIM sampling loop with configurable eta noise parameter
compute_training_losses: compute training losses including masked MSE and velocity MSE for a single diffusion timestep
